environment.hardware: OpenAI container; 5 online vCPUs exposed; CPU-only computation

mathematics.assertion_tested: Finite numerical implementation checks for support pullback, Bellman envelope equality/composition, provenance separation, and 2D convex compaction.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: IEEE-754 float64 real matrices/vectors; deterministic 2D hull comparisons use decimal rounding at 1e-13 in the probe hull routine.
mathematics.conventions: Atoms are row vectors generating C=conv(V); primal branch A acts on dual atoms by v -> v A, representing A^T C; provenance words are stored in chronological primal execution order.
non_claims: The random trials are not a proof of the universal support/Bellman theorems.
The 2D compaction counts are example-specific and do not bound general polytope complexity.
The probe does not establish novelty of support-function or invariant-polytope mathematics.

residual_risks: no independent second implementation of general n-dimensional convex hull reduction is part of this probe
repository copy has no git metadata, so revision is identified by release/archive hashes rather than commit
result: Implementation and finite assertions verified in the stated range; universal mathematical claims are supported separately by proofs in the Episode 008 audit.
